storyline.real: Senna leads from pole except during the stops and wins by nine seconds from Prost, in Prost's last Grand Prix; it is Senna's 41st and last win
storyline.headline: Senna's farewell to McLaren, with Prost off the podium

eras.briefing: Adelaide, 1993. Senna's last race for McLaren and Prost's last race of all. Senna starts from pole; Prost is already champion. Pit board only: hold the lead to the flag. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt to fit the result, the fastest laps and the sourced stops (Jolpica, F1DB, Motor Sport, Wikipedia). The lap-by-lap gaps and running order are synthetic, not history.
